acc.1.text: All six participants are connected. Welcome them and give the instructions from the facilitation guide, then move on to the tutorial.

tuto.1.text: Present the vocabulary, show a placement on the calibration card (Demonstration step), then take the survey.

rel.1.text: Computer, medium screen. I can read down to line 6, no zoom needed.
rel.1.context: Réplique d'un participant simulé au relevé du matériel

rel.2.text: Tablet, small screen. Line 5. A 150% zoom would help.
rel.2.context: Réplique d'un participant simulé au relevé du matériel

rel.3.context: Réplique d'un participant simulé au relevé du matériel

rel.4.context: Réplique d'un participant simulé au relevé du matériel

rel.5.text: I'm on my phone, small screen. I can read down to line 3, I'd need 200% zoom.
rel.5.context: Réplique d'un participant simulé au relevé du matériel

rel.6.context: Réplique d'un participant simulé au relevé du matériel

rel.c.text: Enter each participant's answers in the table, then move on to sorting.

t1.1.text: Setting out an addition means lining up digits in columns. For a pupil with dyspraxia, that is very demanding.

t1.2.text: And you have to copy the numbers before calculating. I'd say Difficult.

t1.c.text: Everyone agrees: one thumbnail is enough. Then ask the ritual question.

t2.1.text: Ordering numbers, there is hardly anything to write. Easy.

t2.2.text: You still have to copy all the numbers in order. Medium for me.

t2.c.text: Disagreement: you need a second thumbnail and the counts. Count who said what, among those present.

t3.1.text: Copying the words, then underlining the stem and circling the suffix: too many fine movements. Without adaptation, it's impossible.
t3.1.context: Carte d'entraînement 3 (colorier radical et suffixe), réplique

t4.1.text: Copying six whole sentences is long and exhausting for a pupil with dyspraxia. Difficult.
t4.1.context: Carte d'entraînement 4 (recopier et entourer le verbe), réplique

t4.2.text: Same as the previous card, isn't it? Where did we put that one?
t4.2.context: Carte d'entraînement 4, réplique piège (rappel d'un jugement précédent)

t4.c1.text: Do not recall previous judgements: each card is judged on its own.

t4.3.text: And then you still have to circle the verb neatly. Difficult.

d.c.text: The tool shows the cards judged Impossible first, then Difficult. Ask the prompt shown, listen, then go to the next card (N).

d3.1.text: With the version where you click on the letters, there is no fine movement left.

d3.2.text: I'd make the letters even bigger.

d3.3.text: And the stem could be shown already separated from the suffix.

d1.1.text: The columns should already be drawn.

d1.2.text: Or one box per digit, so you can't pick the wrong column.

d4.1.text: In the adapted version, you click on the verb: nothing left to copy.

d4.2.text: The sentences just need a bit more space between them.

dx.1.text: I don't have much to add on this one.
dx.1.context: Discussion d'une autre carte, réplique générique

j.c.text: Listen to where the group places the adaptation, move its thumbnail (arrows or keys 1 to 4), then confirm with Enter.

j3.1.text: With the adaptation, I'd put it in Medium.

j3.2.text: Yes, Medium, and even towards the Easy side.

j3.3.text: Agreed: Medium, on the easier side.

j1.1.text: The adaptation helps a bit, but it's still Difficult.

j1.2.text: Difficult, but less than before: on the easier side.

j4.1.text: With nothing to copy, I'd put it in Easy.

jx.1.text: I'd leave it where it is.
jx.1.context: Jugement d'une autre carte, réplique générique

clo.1.text: Thank the participants, then end the session to see your review.

inc.depart.text: P5 has left the video call.
